'''Mount Jerry''' is a [[Location]] on {{Zone|Jerry's Workshop}}.

{{ZoneText|The fiery core of the Jerry Island.|Watch out for eruptions.|Explore the depths.}}

== Features ==
At the end of the {{DarkAqua|23rd of Late Winter}}, '''Mount Jerry''' will begin to erupt, spewing out lava. The volcano will throw out {{MobSprite|Liquid Hot Magma}}s and {{MobSprite|Magma Cube}}s in multiple waves in order to defend the gift piles in {{zone|Jerry's Workshop}}.
